snapshot: Frozen delivery snapshot of historical evidence, not a claim of latest available statistics or final scientific authority.

HKFYG2024.title: Enabling Robust Cross-border Health Services for Hong Kong Residents
HKFYG2024.publisher: Hong Kong Federation of Youth Groups, Youth Research Centre
HKFYG2024.method: Face-to-face computer-assisted interviews by Social Policy Research Limited at 10 randomly selected locations drawn from over 150 MTR, light rail and principal bus terminals; eligible passers-by invited.
HKFYG2024.instrument: Appendix 1 printed pp69–73; V11–V18 relevant. Interview opens with healthcare before consumption questions.
HKFYG2024.weighting: No weighting or response-rate information located in methods section or text search.
limits: Random location selection does not by itself produce a probability sample of all residents. People using transport nodes may differ systematically from less-mobile residents.
Ages over 74 excluded. Street-intercept selection and healthcare priming may affect answers.
Cross-sectional recalled past-year experiences, not trips, expenditure shares, or a trend.
Destination item is medical-services-specific; never label as all northbound destinations.
Multiple-response activities do not form a 100% partition. Medical main-consumption item V12 (74 people) differs from any-medical-experience V13 (181 people); do not merge.

derived_groups.label: No northbound consumption in past year

DH2025_HHB246.scope: Seven newly added pilot providers; excludes two pre-existing HKU–Shenzhen Hospital service points.
DH2025_HHB246.observations: Administrative claim transactions and rounded amounts, inception through 2024-12-31; not equal exposure periods.

units.reported_persons: Reported users/persons; deduplication method not documented

DH2025_HHB246.residence_warning: Table header implies GBA usual residents, but printed city percentages arithmetically use all 9,064 reported users. Both calculated bases are explicit. Remaining users must not be labeled Hong Kong residents.
inference_limits: Not all cross-border medical use, costs, provider income or profits.
Unequal operating windows and case/service mix prevent performance rankings.
Residence reports cannot establish commuter status, identity, motivation or household arrangements.
No population non-user denominator or deduplication method supplied.

corrections.handling: Display calculated percentage only with correction note; coarse groups preferred.

corrections.issue: 65–74 total percentage printed 10.0% rather than 100.0%. Counts reconcile; supplied rows omit erroneous total.

corrections.handling: Use counts or explicitly named denominator, never silently inherit header.

DH2026_HHB248.scope: 19 pilot providers reporting calendar-year 2025 claims; 12 joined during 2025. Excludes pre-existing HKU–SZH service points.
DH2026_HHB248.rounding_reconciliation: Provider rounded rows sum HK$1,000 above published total. Use published total for shares; do not alter any row to force reconciliation.
DH2026_HHB248.comparability: 2024 includes seven providers with partial-year exposure; 2025 includes those seven plus twelve midyear additions. No causal or performance conclusion from changes in shares.
limits: Provider totals only. Service-category allocation discrepancies across report vintages are not resolved.
Do not substitute nearby cumulative-since-launch data.
2024 residence findings have not been refreshed by this annual provider table.
